name: GENE Complete Site
author: onecraftne

sections.description:
GENE Complete Site turns a blank WordPress install into a complete, multi-page website in one click.

Open the Complete Site screen, pick a color, preview the pages, and press Create. A whole website appears — Home, About, Services and Contact — each page sharing the same header, footer and navigation, all built from native WordPress core blocks and ready to edit with the editor you already know.

It is not a blank template you have to fill in, and not a sprawling pattern library to dig through. It generates a finished, coherent site you can publish as-is and then make your own.

What you get — free

  • A complete website, in one click — four linked pages (Home / About / Services / Contact) with a shared header, footer and menu, generated together.
  • The clean “White” design — a calm, modern, WordPress-native look (generous whitespace, clear type, a restrained accent color). Designed to look finished out of the box.
  • 7 color palettes — Blue, Emerald, Violet, Rose, Amber, Teal and Charcoal. The accent flows through links, buttons and highlights so the whole site matches your brand instantly.
  • Set up automatically (optional) — publish the pages, make Home your front page, and build a navigation menu in one step. Or keep everything as private drafts to review first.
  • Visual preview — see each page in your chosen color before you create it.

Built on core blocks — no lock-in

Every page is standard WordPress markup (group, columns, heading, paragraph, image, buttons). That means full editability, compatibility with any block-aware theme, and content that stays intact if you ever deactivate the plugin — you only lose the design styling. No page builder, no frameworks, no bloat.

Want more designs and features?

A separate companion product, GENE Complete Site Pro, adds two more designs (Cinematic and Warm), built-in SEO, a working contact form, client-delivery locking (lock the structure so clients can only edit text and images) and block export / import. Pro is a standalone product available at https://gene-wp.com/ — it is not an upgrade that unlocks this plugin; everything in GENE Complete Site stays free.

sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Upload the gene-section-builder.zip file and click Install Now.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. Open GENE Complete Site > Complete Site in the admin menu, pick a color, preview, and click Create.
sections.faq:
Does this require a specific theme?

No. GENE Complete Site works with any block-aware WordPress theme. (Classic navigation menus appear in classic-style themes; on block/full-site-editing themes the front-page setting still applies but the menu may need to be placed in the site editor.)

Can I edit the generated pages?

Yes. The pages are regular WordPress core blocks. You can edit every part — text, images, colors, spacing — with the normal editor.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

Your pages stay. They are native core blocks created at generation time, so they keep working. You only lose the design CSS polish.

Is this a page builder?

No. It generates standard WordPress pages on core blocks — there is no proprietary builder and nothing to lock you in.

Is there a paid version?

GENE Complete Site is free. Two more designs (Cinematic and Warm), SEO, a contact form, client-delivery locking and block export/import are part of a separate product, GENE Complete Site Pro (https://gene-wp.com/). It is a standalone product, not an unlock of this plugin; everything described above stays free.
sections.changelog:
3.3.0

  • New: Complete Site generation — build a whole multi-page website (Home, About, Services, Contact) with a shared header, footer and navigation, in one click, on native core blocks. Optionally publish the pages, set the front page and create a navigation menu automatically.
  • New: the clean White design — a calm, WordPress-native look with generous whitespace and a restrained accent color.
  • New: a latest articles section on the home page that automatically lists your most recent posts.
  • New: choose at generation time whether to use your theme’s own header and footer, or the matching header and footer the generator builds.
  • Improved: header, footer and in-page links now work (page navigation, email and phone).
  • Improved: small-screen polish — long footer emails and links wrap instead of overflowing.
  • Changed: the plugin is now a complete-site generator. The previous in-editor Section Builder block has been retired in favor of one-click whole-site generation. (The premium Cinematic and Warm designs, SEO, a contact form and client-delivery locking are part of GENE Complete Site Pro.)
  • Note: pages generated with earlier versions are native core blocks and keep rendering.

3.2.0

  • Generate a complete, professionally designed Home page in one click, with built-in motion and four industry designs. (Superseded by the 3.3.0 Complete Site generator.)

3.1.1

  • Fix: removed thin gaps between adjacent full-width sections; prevented a small horizontal scrollbar on some themes.

3.1.0

  • Rebuilt around distinct industry designs with a visual preview and Japanese admin/editor UI.

3.0.0

  • Industry-based picker.

2.0.0

  • Redesigned around color palettes (color-agnostic templates via CSS variables).

1.0.0

  • Initial release with Section Builder block.
